# @ratmath/graphics

> Exact-rational graphics for RatMath: fast float sketches while exploring, certified pixel-exact plots when settled; graphs, parametric and polar curves, regions, exact geometry, and exports to SVG, TikZ, PDF, PNG and text. Part of the RatMath Shelf; numbers come from @ratmath/core (a peer dependency). ESM: `import * as graphics from "@ratmath/graphics"`.

Built from 0.1.0, commit 17713ff. `file:line` is relative to the package root (also node_modules/@ratmath/graphics/); on GitHub: https://github.com/ratmath/graphics/blob/17713ff/<file>#L<line>. Docs pages are under https://ratmath.com/graphics/. Full types: index.d.ts. `(Q ⇒ E)` is a Refinement: `.quick.value` is the float preview Q at once, `.exact()` the exact E.

Types: `type RationalInput = number | bigint | string | Rational`; `type Params = Record<string, RationalInput>`; `type FloatStage<T> = { stage: "float"; exact: false; value: T; trust: "good" | "rough" | "unsure" }`; `type ProgressStage<P = unknown> = { stage: "progress"; exact: false; done: number; of: number; step?: string; partial?: P }`; `type ExactStage<E> = { stage: "exact"; exact: true; value: E; via: string }`; `type Intersection = Zero & Valued`; `type DataPoint = [RationalInput, RationalInput] | { x: RationalInput; y: RationalInput }`; `type PointInput = Point | [Coord, Coord] | { x: Coord; y: Coord }`; `type Shape = Point | Line | Polygon | Circle`; `type ExactCoordinate = { value: Rational; text: string; tex: string; closedForm: true } | AlgebraicForm`; `type ConicType = "circle" | "ellipse" | "parabola" | "hyperbola" | "two lines" | "parallel lines" | "point" | "empty" | "line" | "none"`; `type Polynomial2 = Map<string, Rational>`; `type Layer = Shape | Label | Frame | ({ item: Shape | Frame } & Style)`; `type Fn = string | Ast | { ast: Ast }`; `type Certified = Rational | RationalInterval`; `type End = RationalInput`; `type RiemannRule = "left" | "right" | "midpoint" | "trapezoid" | "lower" | "upper"`; `type Item3d = Surface3d | Curve3d | Points3d | Arrow3d | Faces3d`; `type Num = number | bigint | string | Rational | { toNumber(): number } | { low: unknown; high: unknown }`; `type XY = [number, number]`; `type FigureStatus = "exact" | "certified" | "estimated" | "simulated"`; `type Positions = Map<string, XY>`; `type FloatMap = ((x: number) => number) | { float(x: number): number }`

## Docs

- https://ratmath.com/graphics/llms-full.txt: every page below as Markdown, each with a runnable example
- Pages: index (Introduction), reference (Reference), explore (Explore), fast-certified (Fast, then certified), graphs (Graphs and features), curves (Curves, data and slope fields), implicit (Implicit curves), geometry (Exact geometry), regions (Regions and inequalities), calculus (Calculus pictures), space (Surfaces and space curves), animation (Animation), drawing (Drawing and labels), export (Exporting), figures (Figures for the Shelf), stats-charts (Charts for statistics), finance-charts (Charts for finance), graph-drawing (Drawing graphs), logic-diagrams (Logic diagrams), dynamics-pictures (Pictures of dynamics), equation-pictures (Phase portraits and curvature), numerical-pictures (Pictures of numerical methods)

## Namespaces

- `interval` (src/interval.js): isFinite, floorDiv, ceilDiv, bitLength, isqrt, context, WHOLE, resetClipped, wasClipped, fromRational, fromBounds, width, hull, intersect, containsZero, add, neg, sub, mul, sqr, recip, div, powInt, abs, min, max, sqrt, piInterval, log, exp, sin, cos, powPos, tan, special, atan, sinh, tanh, cbrt, erf, asin, acos, cosh, log1p, powOddRoot, toNumber, toFraction

## Example

```js
import { viewport, graph, zeros, line, circle, intersect, sceneSVG } from "@ratmath/graphics";
const vp = viewport({ x: [-4, 4], y: [-3, 3], width: 400, height: 300 });
const g = graph("x^3/4 - x", {}, vp);
console.log("zeros:", zeros("x^3/4 - x", {}, [-4, 4]).exact().map((z) => String(z.at)));
const pts = intersect(line("y = x"), circle([0, 0], 2));
console.log("y = x meets the circle at", pts.map(String));
SHOW(sceneSVG(vp, [g.exact(), { item: circle([0, 0], 2), color: "#dc2626" }, ...pts.map((p) => ({ item: p, color: "#111", label: true }))], { axes: true, background: "#fff" }));
```
